title: Knowing God
author: J.I. Packer
description: A classic exploration of God's character and attributes. Helps readers understand who God truly is, how He relates to His people, and how to grow in intimacy with Him.

title: The Good Fight
author: John Bevere
description: Understanding spiritual warfare, God's purpose, and living out your faith with confidence despite opposition.

title: Blessings Overtake You
author: John Bevere
description: Explores God's heart toward His people and how blessings flow from obedience and right relationship with God.

title: The Psalms
author: David & Others
description: Raw, honest prayers expressing every human emotion—praise, lament, anger, hope. The Psalms model how to pray authentically.

title: Jesus's Teachings on Prayer (Compiled)
author: Jesus (Gospel accounts)
description: A collection of Jesus's direct teachings and parables about prayer, including the Lord's Prayer, teachings on faith, persistence, forgiveness, and praying in His name.
reference: See resources/jesus-teachings-on-prayer.md for full scripture references

title: The Lord's Prayer
author: Jesus
description: Matthew 6:9-13 — The prayer Jesus taught His disciples. A model for all Christian prayer.
